title: Hybrid CPU+GPU executor for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Build the hybrid executor that schedules CPU and GPU stages on a
single host: rayon workers paired with HIP streams, async overlap
of CPU batch N+1 against GPU batch N, branching-DAG topology
support, resume / heartbeat across the hybrid path, and the
failure-mode wiring (OOM auto-fallback, kernel hard-fail with
diagnostic dump).

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing-blocked on
both the CPU foundation story and the GPU stages story; pulls
their primitives together into a working pipeline.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-11 (user-approved §11 alignment — no rigor
dropped).** Criterion-2 originally read "Hybrid path produces
byte-identity for the four deterministic columns vs CPU-only path
on a representative chain". It was authored at breakdown
(2026-06-05), before the Q3 §11 relaxation (user-approved
2026-06-07) excluded `mean_iters` from every CPU-vs-GPU comparison
(RDNA2 transcendental ULP drift) — a 4-column assertion against a
CPU-only reference is physically unsatisfiable for a run with GPU
stages active. Amended to the §11-coherent pair below: the
strictest satisfiable reading (4-column on the hybrid executor's
CPU arm AND 3-column CPU-vs-GPU), matching the contract every
other CPU-vs-GPU comparison in the epic uses.

## Deliverables (themes)

- Pipeline scheduler: rayon worker pool, HIP stream per worker,
  CPU↔GPU async overlap.
- DAG topology executor: build-time topology check via
  connector typestate; runtime topo sort.
- Resume / heartbeat checkpointing across in-flight GPU batches
  (drain semantics, schema from Phase 0 design doc).
- Failure-mode wiring: OOM ⇒ auto-fallback to CPU + `tracing::warn`;
  kernel / driver error ⇒ hard fail with diagnostic dump.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Hybrid-executor determinism (§11-coherent pair, amended
  2026-06-11): (a) the hybrid executor's CPU arm produces
  byte-identity for the four deterministic columns
  (`fer` / `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters`) vs the SSOT CPU
  reference path on a representative chain; (b) the CPU-vs-GPU
  comparison on a representative chain produces byte-identity for
  the three §11 columns (`fer` / `frames` / `errors`), with
  `mean_iters` logged not asserted (per `ec530af9` §11, Q3
  user-approved 2026-06-07).
- [hard] Receipt artefact under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/hybrid-executor-receipts.md` records
  the combined CPU+GPU throughput on the calibration chain.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the executor's worker / stream
  pairing model and the failure-mode policy.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
